description: “From the time I first ran for office, and throughout the time our districts overlapped when Frank Baker served as a district councilor, he has always been open and responsive to me, and made sure his office is there for anyone who calls, said Representative Brandy Fluker-Reid. The people of Boston deserve a leader who will listen, pick up the phone, and actually help them. That’s who Frank is and why I’m thrilled to endorse him.

title: Representative Brandy Fluker-Reid Endorses Frank Baker For Councilor At-Large Citing His Experience to Deliver Results For The 12th Suffolk Boston Communities
